# {title}

> Copy this template when recording an architecture or governance decision. Remove this instruction block before review.

## Context

What situation or problem prompted a decision? Include constraints and forces at play.

## Decision

What was decided? State clearly and unambiguously.

## Rationale

Why this option over alternatives? Reference research, threat models, or governance principles as applicable.

## Consequences

### Positive

What becomes easier or safer as a result?

### Negative

What trade-offs or new obligations does this introduce?

## Alternatives considered

Brief summary of options not chosen and why they were rejected.

## Related decisions

Links to RFCs, other decision records, or specification documents affected by or dependent on this decision.

## Follow-up

Actions required (RFC drafts, spec updates, diagram revisions). Leave empty if none.
